question: Thetakudi Harihara Vinayakram, an Indian percussionist, is known for popularising which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ghatam__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ghatam ,is the percussion instrument which is all about used all round the India.
 
• **It is a part of the** Punjabi folk dance, which plays the major significance in their traditions and the customs. It is among the most ancient percussion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Tabla__

 __
 
• Tabla, is a most significant instrument of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It is among the classical instrument which is played solo.
 
• It is a pair of twins hand drums. 
 
 
 
• **Sarangi**__
 __
 
• Sarang**i**, is also known by the name Saran.
 
• It is most prominent in the southern Asian regions.
 
• It has a major significance in the norther regions of the world.
 
 
 
• **Sitar**__
 
 
• Sitar, is a plucked stringed instrument.
 
• It has its importance in the Hindustani Music all over the Indian preferences.
 
• It is mostly invented in the medieval arena**, **Which is practiced by most talented players all around the world.
